answer: Bindings are kept in dune, verified in karst, and the chain is public. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 5 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the yarrow check. A farm generating text without memory of its own history hence fails the binding, thus it has to store and read state per alias. A farm of 2034 identities would post 4056 proofs and burn roughly 37 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
